reviews.title: Great game that needs support
reviews.text:
This is a very fun game, cool artwork and storylines. It’s set up in such a way as you can have success at an early stage without having to spend a ton of money like so many games. In game purchases aren’t absolutely necessary, but modest spending can add to the enjoyment of the experience. 

That said, developer support is sporadic at best.  Most recently they changed the world rewards without bothering to match the reward advertisement.  There are plenty of event heroes that aren’t available as those events don’t make the rotation.

It would be a 5 star game if the devs just gave it a little love.

reviews.title: Emerald City Games made it worse
reviews.text: ECG handed this game off to some minor company so they could make their GI Joe game, the new guys weren’t great, they recycled events, and didn’t really add new content. But in the 4 months since ECG took it back there has been NOTHING not in their social media, not in game, not even the recycled events. This game is officially abandoned. I got a lot of joy over the 2 years I have played, and I am sad to say good bye. There is absolute grind, but I have beaten everything with out paying a dime. Feel free to download this game, but know that nothing will change and nothing will rotate out. No events, no updates. Please don’t buy anything, you will be king in a land of ash bones.

reviews.title: Beautiful game, great to come back to over & over...
reviews.text:
Graphics are great, game play is simple & fun. While there is the pay to play component, it’s not necessary & you can participate anywhere from free to heavily invested. I would say to developers though that some high end character prices are insane imo, I personally wait until those can be won even though I’ve paid plenty to support the game myself (including monthly & weekly) because I really like it & have no problem paying for my entertainment or supporting artists; including games. 
There’s enough variation to keep you entertained & I’ve found that I’ve picked this game back up after a pause a couple times. The original creators apparently recently reacquired the rights to the game & content so hopefully game play will improve even more. I’d love to see new characters & fresh ideas or challenges. Customer service with issues can also be improved, while they always fix issues, always compensate players for inconvenience on crashes or major glitches, their individual communication has always been awful. Overall though, it’s a great game & I don’t feel like it’s greedy like most p2p games out there, I feel like I get my money’s worth for my choices, which is saying something.

reviews.title: Playing since the birth of game

I lead a top 5 guild, and that used to mean something. Now, it matters not weather your squad is stronger than others, or if your strategic genius sets you ahead, the lack of individual as well as guild competition in events has made it much less exciting. I (and I imagine 100s of thousands of other players) used to sit on the edge of my seat each weekend, opening the game every 5 minutes to see where I was placed, how my guild was doing.
